description: He is an 18-year-old who can change your outlook on humanity, and give you hope. Yesterday I joined Congressmen Seth Moulton and Jake Auchincloss in meeting now-former 18-year-old detainee Marcelo Gomes da Silva as he was released after six days of custody from the Burlington ICE facility. Marcelo committed no crime except for the misdemeanor of overstaying his visa 11 years ago, when he was seven years old. As he said to an ICE officer, […]
